text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That pathetic run last time... A wave of 
bitterness washes over me every time it 
crosses my mind."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will avenge that day's defeat right 
here. ……No, I must avenge it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because I am an Umamusume of the Mejiro 
family...!
choice_data_list: Let's run with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My power, my resolve... I shall pour 
all of it into this race!
